questions.q: Why does Wilkerson say the Great Migration is often omitted from textbooks?
a: It was not a single unified movement
It was too recent to study
It only involved a few people

questions.q: What economic system kept many black sharecroppers indebted?

questions.q: What housing condition did migrants face in Chicago?
